items.q: What is the fee for the beautician course in Belagavi?
items.a: Beautician course fees at our Belagavi centre vary by batch type and inclusions. Please WhatsApp or call us for the latest fee structure, EMI options and any current scholarships or batch discounts.

items.q: Where is your Belagavi academy located?
items.a: Master Beauty Academy Belagavi is on the 2nd Floor of Khade Bazar Main Road, easily reachable from Tilakwadi, Camp, Shahapur and Vadgaon. The centre is a short auto ride from Belagavi Central Bus Stand.

items.q: Which is the best beauty academy in Belagavi?
items.a: Master Beauty Academy is widely regarded as Belagavi's leading professional beautician training institute, with senior trainers, small batches, live-client practice and a 95% placement rate across Karnataka.

items.q: What are the batch timings at the Belagavi centre?
items.a: We run two batches at Belagavi: a morning batch from 10 am to 1 pm and an evening batch from 3 pm to 6 pm. New batches typically start every 4 to 6 weeks.

items.q: Do you offer placement after the Belagavi course?
items.a: Yes. Belagavi graduates are placed with partner salons across Belagavi, Hubballi and major Karnataka cities. Placement support includes resume building, mock interviews and trial-day coordination.
